name: Rayman® Origins
description:
Rayman is back! Jump into this all new adventure full of surprises and epic boss battles.

-Play as Rayman or Globox and explore Rayman's magical universe

-Discover over 60 platforming levels

-Share your progress, unlocked achievements and more via StreetPass™
disclaimer: You may need an additional compatible SD card or SDHC card with available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
